title: cli + metadata-protocol: `os migrate` moves package-less overlay rows into <base>.custom as declared overrides — the migration ceremony only (the close is N-16b)
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P1, cut after ADR-0146's rewrite merged in #28295); Q5 「全部同意」: package-less overlay writes are closed after the migration. Split 2026-11-01 on the schedule review: the close half moved to #28576 so no release lands between a closed write and Studio's replacement. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28407, #28410

Part of #28236 (P1, child **N-16a**) · governs: ADR-0146 D11 (migrate), decided-here item 6, ADR-0070 D5 (migration affordance) · lane: `domain:server` (`packages/cli`, `packages/metadata-protocol`) · size: M.

**Business reason.** A Setup "customize" of a HotCRM view is a row of no package today: it never exports or reaches another environment. This card moves those rows into `hotcrm.custom` as declared overrides, on the administrator's command. Stopping new ones is #28576.

**Measured (`75ecaf4ad8`).**
- A package-less row is `sys_metadata` with `package_id` NULL (`metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata.object.ts`). The write is open for the five `allowEnvironmentOverlay` types (`protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts:56#refusePackagedBaseOverride`).
- `protocol-environment-rows.ts:212#packagelessContentPackage` serves a shipped name's own row, else the unbound row, else its code item. `:152#packagelessAddress` sends a package-less save to the sole stored binding: after a move, a package-less `PUT` lands on the `.custom` row.
- Writers: Setup's overlay save / reset (`views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`) and Studio's "Customize with an overlay" link (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx:843–865`).
- Ceremony precedent: `os migrate security-catalog-overlays` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/`; list, `--apply`, `--yes`, `--json`).
- Since (`35b178bd0a`): N-10 landed (PR #28507). `served-override.ts:85#isServedOverrideRowOf` is the one predicate for "this row is the served override", and `protocol.ts:2875#servedOverlayRowCandidates` serves a declaring pair row ahead of the unbound row. So a Studio customization (N-17) made before the ceremony runs shadows an unmigrated row of the same name.
- `POST /packages/:id/adopt-orphans` (`runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:2437`, `reassignOrphanedMetadata`) rebinds every package-less row into one writable package, with no declaration and no shipped-name check.
- Whether Setup's form save (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`) carries an `overrides` key it did not draw: not verified.

**Wanted.**
1. **Migrate.** One `os migrate` ceremony, not a boot step. It lists each package-less row of a name exactly one code package ships, and with `--apply` moves it into that base's `<base>.custom`.
   - The pair is ensured through N-13's door, the only creation path.
   - The body gains `overrides: { package, basedOn }`, with `basedOn` = the installed base package's `manifest.version` at migration (ADR-0146 D2 as amended by #28486).
   - It writes through N-09's gate and keeps the row's state (active or draft).
   - The unbound row is removed only after the declared row reads back as served (`isServedOverrideRowOf`).
   - Idempotent: a second run moves 0. The report is per base.
2. **Left alone:**
   - a row of a name no package ships (environment metadata);
   - a name several packages ship (listed for the administrator);
   - permission / position rows (D6; their own ceremony exists);
   - a row whose name the pair already overrides (a Studio customization made first, N-17): listed as **shadowed**, never merged or deleted; the report names the two ways out — delete the row, or "Restore package original" in Studio and re-run.
3. Walled postures: the operator runs it; the ensure door's `403` stands.
4. **Until #28576 closes the write**, a package-less save that `packagelessAddress` lands on a pair row keeps that row's `overrides` block when the incoming body carries none (server side, in the save), so Setup's form save and reset keep working on a migrated item instead of being refused by N-09 as undeclared.
5. `adopt-orphans` leaves a package-less row of a shipped name alone and names this ceremony; it keeps rebinding environment metadata (ADR-0070 D5).

**Tests.**
- A row moves with its declaration and serves the same content on all five reads (N-10's read). A re-run moves 0.
- Unshipped, multi-shipped, security-catalog and shadowed rows are untouched; the shadowed one is in the report with both ways out.
- A walled tenant administrator's run is refused at the ensure door (403); the operator's run moves.
- Until #28576: after a move, a package-less save of the item lands on the pair's row (`packagelessAddress`, sole binding) with or without `overrides` in the body, and the item stays served as the declared override. A package-less `DELETE` removes the pair's row and the base's document is served again.
- `adopt-orphans` into a writable package skips a shipped-name row and rebinds an environment one.
- `protocol.org-scoped-write-refused.test.ts` stays green, unchanged.

**Release safety.** After N-16a alone, package-less writes stay open; migrated rows are served by N-10's read, and Setup's save and reset reach them through `packagelessAddress` (item 4 keeps the declaration on that save). N-13 (#28407) makes the pair creatable, and N-09 (#28410) admits the declared row. The ceremony is the one operator step; the release note names it.

**Not here.** Closing the package-less write and the console changes (#28576). The ensure door (N-13); the write gate (N-09); serving a declared override (N-10, landed); Setup route redirects (N-28).

**Dedupe.** Related, closed: #1824 (package-scoped overlays), #22375 (overlay index pre-flight). Searched `package-less overlay`, `overlay package_id null migrate`: no open card migrates or closes the write.

Links back: #28236, ADR-0146 D11, ADR-0005, ADR-0070 D5, ADR-0131 D6/D10.
